notablePrerequisites: You control at least two lands.
description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands to your hand from the battlefield, copying Dark Ritual.
Resolve the copy of Dark Ritual, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting two lands onto the battlefield tapped from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
